Creates the spatial database of a TrentoP sewer network, with its empty layers and its tables of parameters and diameters.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** Sewer network, TrentoP, GeoPackage, PostGIS<br>
**Authors:** Antonello Andrea, Silvia Franceschi, Daniele Andreis<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.TrentoPProjectFilesGenerator`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pUser` | String |  |  | The optional user of the database. |
| `pPassword` | String |  |  | The optional password of the database. |
| `pMode` | String |  | `Project` | The layers and parameters to create: for a project (the design of a new network) or a calibration (the verification of an existing one). Allowed values: `Project`, `Calibration`. |
| `pCode` | CRS code |  |  | The code of the projected reference system of the layers, in meters (ex. EPSG:32632). |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outDatabase` | output file |  | The database to create, or to complete if it exists: a GeoPackage (.gpkg) or H2GIS (.mv.db) file, or a PostGIS database, as jdbc:postgresql://host:port/database. |
